rows.quote: We obtained summary statistics of the genetic associations with plasma protein levels from a study of Ferkingstad et al. (https://www.decode.com/summarydata/) [9] and the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP)( https://registry.opendata.aws/ukbppp/) [10].
